item.title: Identify Offer Red Flags 🚩 • Review benefits—ensure they meet your needs. 💼 • Check for non-compete clauses—avoid future restrictions. • Analyze company culture—research reviews and ratings. • Verify salary alignment—compare industry standards. • Assess work-life balance—ask about flexible policies. What potential deal breakers can you identify in your current offer? #joboffer #career #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
